text:
olivia (payments): Incoming EUR nostro collection posted to our account but no remittance in the SWIFT text. Amount: EUR 27,450.00. Sender bank reference: CHASDEFX20260315/REF00123. Beneficiary name on the MT101 feed is 'Stellara GmbH' but our invoice is under 'Stellara Ltd'. No PO or invoice number in the fields. Can someone start a nostro trace and ask for the full MT103?

josh (reconciliation): Noted. I pulled the incoming file — swift field 70 was empty. Bank gave this transaction id: `CORR-GB-LON-9842`. I'll ping the correspondent but will need an MT103 copy to map payer account.

ops-bot: New support ticket created: PAY-12458. Assigned to josh (reconciliation). ETA for first response: 2h.

mia (customer-success): @olivia can you DM the customer (Stellara) asking for invoice number/PO and payment instructions they used? If they confirm payer account or invoice ID we can short-circuit the trace. I can draft a canned message.

olivia (payments): Sending DM now. Quick draft: "Hi — we received a EUR payment from your bank today but our system didn't get the invoice/PO number. Could you please confirm the invoice number or provide a copy of the bank confirmation (MT103) so we can apply the payment? Thank you!"

josh (reconciliation): Steps I'm taking: 1) Submit MT103 request to correspondent (email + secure portal). 2) Ask for full ordering customer details and remittance text. 3) Check nostro additional fields and value date. If MT103 returns payee info that matches our invoice reference we apply. If not, escalate to AML.

lia (aml): If the name mismatch persists (GmbH vs Ltd) and we can't verify payer account, hold allocation and flag for manual review. I'll standby to approve holds.

josh (reconciliation): Also noting FX route: sender used OUR charges and intermediary was BNP PARIBAS FR. That sometimes strips longer remits. Request: ask correspondent to provide the original line with `/RF/` or `:/INV/` tags — banks sometimes keep legacy tags present in MT103 text.

mia (customer-success): Copied customer on DM. They replied: "Payment sent via corporate treasury — attached remittance PDF, but only shows invoice totals, no internal PO. Bank says reference got truncated on rails." They attached a screenshot.

olivia (payments): Received screenshot — customer reference is `INV-2026-787` in their PDF. Match check: amount matches invoice INV-2026-787 for EUR 27,450.00. Good sign.

josh (reconciliation): If the customer-provided invoice matches, we can manually apply but still request MT103 for audit trail. I'll update PAY-12458 with manual allocation note and attach the customer's remittance.

ops-bot: PAY-12458 updated: manual allocation performed pending MT103. Audit tag added: `manual-alloc-1955554321`.

lia (aml): Approving manual allocate as customer-provided attachment matches our invoice and KYC. Ensure you store the customer's remittance in the payment record.

olivia (payments): Done — applied payment to INV-2026-787 and uploaded customer's PDF. Leaving ticket open until we receive MT103 from correspondent. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

josh (reconciliation): I'll follow up with correspondent again in 24h and close ticket on delivery of MT103. If anyone sees similar patterns from BNP corridor, please add a short note in the shared doc `bank-routing-issues` so we can add a routing rule.

mia (customer-success): Customer happy and confirmed allocation. Closing loop on CS side.

ops-bot: PAY-12458 pending MT103 — will ping after 24h if no response.
_meta: generated for dataset: Slack finance thread about nostro trace and missing remittance
